evals.name: single-slice-happy-path
evals.prompt: I want to add a "copy to clipboard" button next to each code snippet on our docs pages. Clicking it copies the snippet text and briefly shows a "Copied!" confirmation. Let's build it.
evals.expected_output: Frames the work as a single slice, does NOT jump to writing code. Explores the codebase for relevant patterns, then routes into the slice skill to sharpen it into a job story with acceptance criteria before any implementation.

evals.name: epic-detected
evals.prompt: We need to build a full team-billing system: organizations can have multiple members, an admin can invite/remove people, we track per-seat pricing, generate monthly invoices, handle failed payments with retries, and expose a billing dashboard. Let's develop this.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is an epic (many independently shippable pieces), does NOT try to build it all. Names the pieces and asks the user which single slice to build in this pass, or points them at slicing the epic first.

evals.name: resist-jumping-to-code
evals.prompt: Add a `published_at` timestamp to Article so authors can schedule posts to go live in the future. Just implement it.
evals.expected_output: Despite "just implement it", follows the workflow: frames the single slice, grounds it in codebase conventions, sharpens acceptance criteria via slice, then builds test-first with TDD rather than writing production code before a failing test.
